actions: Re-audited current public CPO mask builder/trainer, public 4B ZeRO-3 launcher/offload config, Transformers 4.57.3 ZeRO auto-threshold logic, Qwen3-VL source, and DeepSpeed 0.16.4 parameter-offload implementation.

Executed separate-process streaming mask-disposal peak-RSS benchmarks.
Derived source-level ZeRO-3 CPU-offload transfer byte model and bounded Qwen3-VL-4B conditional scenarios with explicit scope guards.

new_evidence_summary.mask_lifetime: After dense masks are converted to flat nonzero indices in the public trainer, mask values are not used by the regularizer. Source-equivalent streaming disposal preserved tested algebra and reduced synthetic peak RSS and steady tensor bytes.
new_evidence_summary.representation: Dense bool+fp32 refs vs int64 sparse indices+refs has a 12.5% raw break-even; int32 local-index and bit-packed candidates were benchmarked only under torch 2.10 CPU and remain unvalidated for public runtime.
new_evidence_summary.zero3_offload: Public CPU-offload path copies global protected indices/refs to every rank before filtering and copies CPU-offloaded local parameter partitions to the accelerator for masked drift computation. Conditional 4B/10%/8-rank byte model is persisted but is not a measured bus trace.

blockers: No compatible PyTorch 2.8/CUDA/DeepSpeed execution environment was available in this invocation.
No real CPO Qwen3-VL task mask/checkpoint was available for actual support, RSS, GPU peak or bus-traffic measurement.
